title: Verified canonical labelling of finite graphs
abstract: Implements an individualisation-refinement canonical-labelling algorithm in the style of nauty and proves that its canonical adjacency form is invariant under vertex relabelling and classifies finite graphs up to isomorphism. The imported core includes the executable search, refinement, orbit-pruning and backjumping machinery together with its equivariance, termination, soundness and optimality proofs.

informal.IsoGraph.Canon.canonAdj_eq_iff: Two Boolean adjacency functions on Fin n have equal canonical forms exactly when one is a relabelling of the other by a vertex permutation.
informal.IsoGraph.Canon.canonAdj_relabel: Relabelling a finite graph by any permutation leaves its canonical adjacency form unchanged.
informal.IsoGraph.Canon.exists_relabel_of_canonAd: Equality of canonical adjacency forms yields an explicit permutation relating the original adjacency functions.
